# Navimower Map Card 0.3.1-beta1

## Notification panel

This prerelease adds the first read-only Navimow notification view to the Map Card. It uses the **Latest notification** sensor introduced by Navimower integration 0.4.1 and does not call the private cloud directly from the browser.

- Adds a bell icon to the card header.
- Opens a dedicated **Notifications** panel from the bell.
- Shows notification date/time, vendor title, content and vendor code when available.
- Shows **3 notifications per page** by default, with Previous/Next paging when the integration has more retained recent messages.
- Keeps the page-size constant internal for beta1; a visual-editor/YAML setting can be added after the first field test.

## Read / unread state

Navimower 0.4.1 preserves the vendor `read` boolean from the app's Notification -> Device feed, so the card can reflect whether the retained messages have been read in the Navimow app.

- If any retained recent message has `read: false`, the header icon becomes orange (`#FF5A00`) and uses `mdi:bell-badge-outline`.
- If no retained recent message is unread, the bell stays neutral/grey and uses `mdi:bell-outline`.
- Unread rows also receive a small orange dot in the panel.
- Opening the Map Card panel **does not mark a message read**. The state changes only when the vendor feed later reports a different `read` value.

The integration currently retains up to five recent normalized Device-feed messages in the sensor attributes. Therefore beta1's badge reflects unread state within that retained recent set; it does not claim to know the read state of older messages that are no longer present in the sensor.

## Entity discovery and compatibility

The card automatically looks for both current and earlier entity-ID forms, including `sensor.<mower>_latest_notification` and `sensor.<mower>_notification`, and can also find a notification sensor attached to the same Home Assistant mower device.

Navimower integration **0.4.1 or later** is recommended for the notification panel. Existing map, history, controls, schedule editing, outline controls and zone-marker behavior remain unchanged.

## Cache-safe beta loader

HACS now points to the new `navimower-map-card-v031-beta1.js` loader. The filename has not been used by the 0.3.0 stable line, preventing Home Assistant WebView/browser module cache from silently reusing the previous stable loader after upgrading to this beta.
